suites.title: Runtime Cache, Memory Cleanup, Alias Resolution & Form Editor Lifecycle

specs.title: TC_CACHE_001: offline cache survives memory sweeps and reclaims only idle empty entries
TC_MEM_001: memory warning is deduplicated and dispatched only once per high-count period
TC_ALIAS_001: alias cache maintains bounded capacity and prunes stale unused entries according to freshness policy
TC_ALIAS_002: blank inputs and UUID literals bypass alias resolution queries without network dispatch
TC_EDITOR_001: longform editor wrapper maintains component identity and scroll margin across state updates
TC_EDITOR_002: reader composer transitions safely into fullscreen layout without layout breakage or content distortion
TC_FIELD_001: datetime field accepts valid inputs, formats consistently and prevents corrupted states
TC_UI_001: field input spacing maintains visual rhythm without overlap and metadata disclosures expand cleanly
TC_UI_002: remove controls and drag handles render distinct accessible identifiers without accidental trigger
TC_UI_003: add tile conforms to grid alignment and selector border reflects neutral versus active focus state
TC_CACHE_002: corrupted or malformed offline cache entries fail gracefully without wiping valid cache records
TC_CACHE_003: storage quota exhaustion prioritizes offline user drafts and evicts ephemeral caches first
TC_CACHE_004: active in-memory draft is locked against sweep reclamation during concurrent background cleanup
TC_MEM_002: memory threshold flapping across boundary is debounced and emits only a single warning
TC_MEM_003: warning cooldown does not reset when memory only partially recovers
TC_MEM_004: multi-tab memory cleanup events synchronize timestamp to prevent duplicate warnings across tabs
TC_ALIAS_003: alias cache saturation with identical timestamps resolves deterministically
TC_ALIAS_004: alias collision and re-assignment purges stale target mapping immediately
TC_ALIAS_005: zero-capacity alias cache operates safely without retention leaks or crashes
TC_ALIAS_006: malicious input and control characters in alias field are sanitized and rejected
TC_ALIAS_007: pseudo-UUIDs and near-UUID inputs are strictly distinguished from genuine RFC-4122 UUIDs
TC_EDITOR_003: massive formatted content paste maintains editor wrapper stability without memory freeze
TC_EDITOR_004: undo and redo history stack is preserved across forced parent re-renders
TC_EDITOR_005: escape key in fullscreen mode exits fullscreen without abruptly closing composer or losing draft
TC_FIELD_002: invalid calendar dates (non-leap year Feb 29, April 31) are strictly rejected
TC_FIELD_003: cross-timezone datetime conversion preserves exact UTC millisecond timestamp
TC_UI_004: long internationalized labels and RTL text wrap cleanly in metadata disclosures without overflow
TC_UI_005: destructive removal of populated fields enforces confirmation guard to prevent accidental loss
TC_UI_006: drag handle and remove button maintain minimum touch hit-box separation
TC_UI_007: add tile disables cleanly and displays capacity feedback when form reaches maximum field limit
